Smt. Shahnaz Fatma vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 April,
2023
Author: Vivek Kumar Birla

Bench: Vivek Kumar Birla
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 45
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 4920 of 2023
Petitioner :- Smt. Shahnaz Fatma

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Suyash Gupta,Sharad Sharma

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Shashi Kant Shukla Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed by the petitioner and a short counter affidavit filed on behalf of the informant are taken on record.
Heard Shri Sharad Sharma, learned counsel for the petitioner, Shri Shashi Kant Shukla, learned counsel for the informant and Shri G.P. Singh, learned A.G.A. appearing on behalf of the State.

This writ petition has been filed for quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 06.10.2022 in Case Crime No. 311 of 2022, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Ganj, District Rampur and a direction to the respondent authorities not to arrest the petitioner in pursuance of the impugned first information report.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner is that the impugned FIR is based on absolutely false allegations.

The validity of the Will is being questioned by filing the present prosecution but no suit for cancellation of Will was ever filed by the first informant and the suit for injunction, on coming to know about the lodging of the first information report, was filed by the petitioner's side registered as O.S. No. 41 of 2023
and therefore the matter, as to whether the Will is forged or not, is a civil dispute which can be suitably decided in civil proceedings only.

The other factual aspects as to who was taking care of Smt. Nasim Jahan have also been advanced to submit that as the care was being taken by the petitioner therefore she had executed Will dated 23.09.2016 in favour of the petitioner out of her own sweet will.
Submission is therefore that the prosecution is absolutely mala fide and false.

Per contra, Shri Shashi Kant Shukla, learned counsel for the informant submits that in the present case inquiry was done at pre investigation stage and it is only thereafter that the first information report was lodged.

It is submitted that the first inquiry that was conducted by the C.O. District Rampur who had submitted its report dated 03.08.2022 that the dispute is about the validity of its Will deed which can be decided in a civil dispute.

By means of the short counter affidavit submitted by the Additional S.P., Rampur had submitted its report on the direction of ADG and he found that there were different signatures and therefore the offence has been made out and the FSL report is still pending.
Shri G.P. Singh, learned A.G.A. on instructions verified that after issuing notice under Section 91 Cr.P.C. documents have been collected and then sent for FSL report.
In such view of the matter we find that the matter is under investigation by the Investigating Officer and prima facie a cognizable offence is made out.

Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt.
Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
